benchmarks.label: Q1 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). date_histogram (monthly) on optimised_invoices, created_at < cutoff. No schema effect — identical to naive (tier_id not embedded by loader).
Q2 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Single get(optimised_invoices) by ID. Schema effect: embedded lines → 1 round trip (vs 4 in naive). Invoice pool pre-filtered to created_at < cutoff.

Q3 optimised at 10% row-based scale (10% of session IDs). Single get(optimised_sessions) by session_id. Schema effect: native cart array + GET (vs search + JSON parse in naive). No date cutoff — sessions generated in 2025.
Q4 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). 3-step orchestration on optimised indices, orders filtered to created_at < cutoff. No schema effect — identical orchestration to naive.

Q5 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). multi_match best_fields: name^3 / description^1.5 / product_type. Custom English analyser. is_active=True + created_at < cutoff. Schema effect: field boosts + analyser vs naive plain BM25.

Q6 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). range(occurred_at) + term(user_id) on optimised_events. Anchor pool pre-filtered to occurred_at < cutoff. 30-day window centred on anchor — guaranteed non-empty. Schema effect: composite sort optimisation at storage level.

Q7 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Full PostgreSQL-equivalent Q7 on [data_min, cutoff], one server-side search: filters(tier) → date_histogram(min_doc_count=0, extended_bounds) → sum + moving_fn. Data min: 2024-01-08.
